title: Remove-Sustainability-CLEAN27-tags-for-Wave2-2026
summary: Removes code marked for cleanup in version 27 (CLEAN27) from the Sustainability, Power BI Reports, Subscription Billing and E-Document apps. The obsolete Sustainability Power BI embedded pages in Power BI Reports are deleted, and the code and test values that depended on them are removed.
key_points: Deleted 11 obsolete Sustainability Power BI embedded page files from the Power BI Reports _Obsolete folder
Removed CLEAN27-guarded code from Subscription Billing tables, pages and APIs and from the E-Document table
Cleaned obsolete code from Sustainability Power BI pages, codeunits, table and page extensions
Removed related permission set entries and test library enum values
